sample_unit: abstracts (192 summary sentences reviewed by researchers; 34 volunteers rated accessibility/transparency)

links.outcome: Researcher review of AI lay summary sentences for accuracy, relevance, and harmfulness
links.effect: 95.9% accuracy (95% CI 92.1-97.9) and 96.2% relevance (92.4-98.1) across 192 sentences from 33 abstracts; none deemed harmful.
links.quote: ChatGPT achieved 95.9% (95% CI, 92.1-97.9) accuracy and 96.2% (92.4-98.1) relevance across 192 summary sentences from 33 abstracts based on researcher review.

unlisted_practices: Prompt engineering to generate lay-language summaries of scientific abstracts
Precision analysis and adaptive random sampling to determine evaluation sample size
Automated generation and display of AI lay summaries on a research recruitment platform

screen.reason: Evaluated and implemented ChatGPT-generated lay summaries of scientific abstracts onto a real platform (ResearchMatch) for participants/the public, assessing accuracy, readability, and harmfulness, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard/practice comparably.
